info.name: Deribit Account Management Portfolio Management API

items.docs: Cancels all open orders and quotes belonging to the authenticated portfolio. No filter parameters are accepted — the cancel applies to every instrument and every side.

Locks the authenticated portfolio. All currently open `DIRECT_ACCESS` orders and quotes for this portfolio are cancelled immediately. New `DIRECT_ACCESS` orders and quotes are rejected until the portfolio is unlocked.

REST-submitted orders are not affected by the lock state.

Unlocks the authenticated portfolio, resuming normal acceptance of `DIRECT_ACCESS` orders and quotes.

Unlocking the portfolio does **not** restore any previously cancelled orders.
